set_text.text: What is a wholesale to retail markup?

A wholesale to retail markup is what a store adds to your wholesale price to set its shelf price. It is stated as a share of the store's cost. For a distributor it is the second of two steps: your markup sets the case price, then the store's markup sets the shelf.
Your markup and the store's stack on top of each other. They multiply rather than add: your 30% and the store's 66.8% take a $22.00 case to 2.17 times its cost on the shelf.
What the store's share pays for
The $1.59 a unit the store keeps is gross margin. Shelf labor, rent, spoilage and promotions all come out of it before any of it is profit.
The chain fits accounts that resell your case one unit at a time, such as grocers, markets and convenience stores. A restaurant turns a case into plates and prices on food cost instead.
Who uses a wholesale to retail markup calculator
It is built for independent food distributors who sell into grocery and specialty retail. Anyone who sets a case price that a store will resell should check the shelf it leads to.
